column1: # survey: Custom Rates for Farm Services in Missouri (MU Extension guide G302, revised April 2023)
# collected: Statewide survey online and through MU Extension specialists in spring 2023, of rates charged or paid in 2022
# includes: Custom rates cover the cost of machinery, fuel, labor and, occasionally, a product such as lime or bale wrap. Rates exclude the cost of materials being applied.

# range_note: The range is the lowest and highest answer. MU revised G302 in March 2026 from a fall 2025 to winter 2026 survey of 2025 rates; that PDF would not open from here, so this table is the April 2023 guide (2022 rates) until it can be read. The 2026 guide is linked from the MU Extension G302 page.
